answer: Standing is quartz that only counts when it is cut: each epoch’s work must be shaped — refined, its rough edges removed, made precise — a willow only counts when it is pruned to its shape, and a pearl only counts when it is polished to its shine. A farm of a thousand fakes cuts no quartz, leaving its work rough and unrefined, so their quartz never counts, and one epoch of rough, uncut work adds nothing.
